cases.title: With the pipe layer locked, CDEDIT refuses one pipe and two pipes, names the layer, opens no editor and changes no level text
cases.plan_item: Native protection rule: locked pipe layer (triage group L2); BUG-384 batch wording; BUG-797 level cascade on a locked pipe layer
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with BUG-384 (expected: a plain line saying the pipe layer is locked and nothing was changed, CE will not unlock it), BUG-797 and BUG-254 as written in BUG_CARPARK.md, and the native protection rule in AGENTS.md. BUG-797 and BUG-254 are not claimed.
cases.expected: Lock the layer STORMWATER PIPE (AutoCAD's own -LAYER Lock). CDEDIT with pipe P3 (10A98D) picked first prints the refusal sentence naming the layer and says CE will not unlock it and nothing was changed; no Edit Pipe window opens. The same with two pipes picked: a plain locked-layer sentence, no 'Edit 2 Pipes' window. Every 'IL ' text of the drawing reads as before.
cases.why_not_unit: It needs AutoCAD's real layer lock and the real CDEDIT selection route.
not_automated: BUG-797 (level cascade on a locked pipe layer) is NOT claimed: CDEDIT refuses before any cascade can start, and CDPROPAGATE is not driven.
That the layer is STILL locked afterwards is shown only by the second refusal (CE would not have refused if it had unlocked the layer); the layer's lock flag itself is not read.
Pits on a locked layer, locked text layers and Xrefs are not covered (triage groups L1 and others).

cases.title: After CDEDIT the pipes you had selected are still selected
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with daily card D17 (DAILY_TOOLS_TEST_CASES_2026-10-23.md): one pipe selected stays selected after Edit Pipe Save; two pipes stay selected after the Edit 2 Pipes editor is closed. The second pipe is the first other pipe in the drawing, not a pipe named by the card.
cases.expected: Pick pipe P3 (10A98D) first, run CDEDIT, answer Y, press Save in Edit Pipe with nothing changed: the selection is still exactly 10A98D. Then pick P3 and the new pipe together, run CDEDIT, close the editor that opens by its Cancel: the selection is still exactly those two. No CE window is left open at the end.
cases.why_not_unit: Selection restore runs against AutoCAD's live implied selection after a real modal window.
not_automated: The batch editor for two pipes is titled "Edit 2 Pipes" on 3.0.72 (read on 24 Oct 2026). If no editor closes by Cancel the step is BLOCKED.
Whether the first Save changed the drawing is not checked (the drawing's change counter is not read).
